svg.title: ryu_practice_yard site plan
svg.text: ryu_practice_yard · Ryu Survey compound (alias ryu_yard; + ryu_yard_street, ryu_office, ryu_yard_roof, ryu_training_gate)
Site plan in metres, north up. Western Mangwon-dong (Mangwon 2-dong), Mapo-gu: about 12 minutes' walk from Taeo's flat. Fictional, no real address.
The keyed practice yard follows the Codex key world/keys/ryu_practice_yard/. The west strip, the back strip and everything in them are decided here from the scripts.
YARD STREET (ryu_yard_street): plane tree, parked scooters, low buildings, wires

INSET · ryu_office (office container, ch10): 6.0 × 2.4 m, h 2.3 m
a padded bench along the back (west) wall, facing the
door: Minho sleeps here; shelf of files above
b small fridge, electric kettle, jug of barley tea
c Seonhee's desk facing the south wall: ledger, roll
calculator, cash box, lamp; corkboard of Bluebird notices
above
d Dongsik's corner: radio base station at wheelchair
height, wall map with coloured pins, framed photo
e folding table, battered laptop, plastic stools, crates
f gas heater. One fluorescent tube; sun through the east
window and door in the morning
Door: middle of the EAST wall; the one window is just
SOUTH of it (key; ch10 said north). Looking in from the
door: bench ahead, Seonhee LEFT (south), Dongsik RIGHT
(north).

INSET · ryu_yard_roof (workshop roof, ch20): seating lock P13–P49
East head: Kw Kwak (the only plastic armchair), Da
Dami on a stool at his NE corner.
North side, W→E: Ha Haein, Mi Minho (grill, tongs,
phone), Se Sejin (medic bag).
South side, backs to the parapet and the city,
W→E: Ni Nib (blue crate), Ta Taeo (stool,
backpack, patch out), Eu Eunchae.
Stair: outside steel stair up the WEST wall to the
NW corner. NE: blue water tank. East parapet:
lettuce + chilli planters. The SE corner looks
down into the keyed yard; the south parapet over
the compound to the street; far SW, a lit Han
River bridge (Seongsan Br.).
ch22: same roof, the party table gone: four
upturned crates, a camping lantern, cup noodles.
ch23 opens here (its note's "office roof" is a
slip). ch82: Minho's line "on the yard roof".
scale: 18.5 px = 1 m (site); insets larger
Codex key camera
script camera (chapter·panel)
KEY · KEYED PRACTICE YARD
1 Grey corrugated office container (ryu_office), SW; door
mid-east wall, window just south of it. Grey, never white
(key; ch23).
2 Keyed concrete step + a removable wheelchair ramp beside it
for Dongsik (ch10–12: metal; ch26 calls it timber, flagged).
3 Van stand, SE, nose west (key). Whichever van is "on stand"
parks here; the key's van carries a blank blue repossession
sticker.
4 Plywood radio maze (schematic; the key fixes the screens):
entrance south-centre, exit NE. Never rebuilt or widened.
5 Three round practice targets on the north fence.
6 Equipment trestle west of the maze: radios, a radio in
pieces, cable, toolbox; Haein's night work under a work lamp
7 Orange safety vest on the west fence.
8 Drums, leaning boards and an olive crate along the east
fence.
9 Rolling scaffold tower (deck 2.5 m), wheeled in:
ch7/ch9/ch12 observation platform; the collapsing scaffold of
ch25.
10 Double vehicle gate centred on the south fence; the
pedestrian gate is a chain-link wicket in its west leaf
(decided here).
11 Orrin's wide lane along the east fence, padded loading stop
at its north end: ch26 AAO course only.
KEY · OUTSIDE THE KEY (decided here)
12 The container home (ch26 offer; Taeo and Nib from
ch28): a 20-ft unit behind the office in the west strip,
door facing east. The crew rules (ch45) hang inside, on
the wall facing the door.
13 Path along the yard fence; chain-link door in the
strip's orange-meshed frontage.
14 3.5 m panel gate in the yard's west fence: Orrin's way
between the yard and the strip.
15 Open ground ("the adjoining open yard", ch26 P45);
Orrin's tarp awning, his bed ch24–33.
16 Haein's workshop, one storey, 8 × 6 m, roller door
south; its flat roof is ryu_yard_roof.
17 Outside steel stair up the workshop's WEST wall to the
roof's NW corner.
18 North service bay, open-sided shed, three van spaces:
three vans to ch12 ("along the far fence"), the second van
here in ch20–22.
19 Sliding vehicle gate onto the back lane (ch12's gate
"in the far fence").
20 Training-gate cage (ryu_training_gate, ch12), the
compound's back-right corner: 3 × 3 m, padlocked mesh
door, the slit by the back fence facing it, chalk line 2 m
out, two blue crates.
21 Scaffold tower when stored.
CAMERAS + LOCKS
K1 from the south gate looking north (key
wide; 10 a.m. sun from the SE). K2 from the
targets looking south: office RIGHT, van
LEFT.
• Vans: 3 (to the ch12 tow) → 2 (older on
the SE stand, second in the bay; ch21
bumper mark, ch22 strip on the older) → 1
(ch23 P19 seizure; the last van moves to
the SE stand, blank blue sticker) → 0
(towed ch29) → 1 from ch34 (Ryu redeems it
after ch33; decided here; no sticker).
• The party roof is the workshop roof, never
the office.
• After ch28 "the yard" is Taeo's home
(container door ch43, ch47; rules ch45;
relay frames ch89, ch93). The crew's work
base from ch33 is mapo_tyre_base.
